n6395d7b863.headline: ReNew Energy Global :  Announces Results for the Second Quarter for Fiscal Year 2026 (Q2 FY26), ended September 30, 2025; Reports 84% net profit increase YOY in H1 FY2026
n6395d7b863.summary: ReNew Energy Global reported unaudited IFRS results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. It said net profit rose 84% year on year in the first half of fiscal 2026.
n6395d7b863.why: ReNew is an Indian renewable energy developer, and its results reflect demand for clean power projects in India, a key market for global energy investors.

n9ef3ec3a83.headline: Countdown is on for new
n9ef3ec3a83.summary: Accountancy specialists confirmed small business owners' and self-employed workers' concerns about the Verifactu invoicing system, which goes live in 2026. They also offered assurances on how it will work.
n9ef3ec3a83.why: Verifactu is Spain's mandated anti-fraud invoicing software regime, and compliance requirements affect how small businesses handle tax reporting and cash flow.

n12df002b6b.headline: Government raises public sector salaries, minimum wage by 9% for 2026
n12df002b6b.summary: The Ghanaian government approved a 9% salary increase for all public sector workers under the Single Spine Salary Structure ahead of the 2026 budget statement.
n12df002b6b.why: Public sector wage decisions feed into government spending and fiscal planning, which matter for Ghana's sovereign debt and inflation outlook.

n6f350b916b.headline: EVs take record share of used car market
n6f350b916b.summary: One in 25 used car buyers is now choosing an electric vehicle, according to the Somerset County Gazette. The report describes a record share for the segment.
n6f350b916b.why: The used-car market shapes residual values and demand for EVs, which affects automakers and battery supply chains.

n008a3ff316.headline: Russia’s Inbound Tourism Falls 6.3% in 2025 as Chinese and UAE Visitors Decline
n008a3ff316.summary: Inbound tourism to Russia fell 6.3% in summer 2025 as arrivals from China and the UAE declined, partly offset by growth from Saudi Arabia, Oman and India.
n008a3ff316.why: Tourism receipts contribute to services exports and hotel and airline revenues, making visitor trends relevant to the Russian services economy.

nca20c64311.headline: Guinness maker Diageo hires former Tesco boss for top job
nca20c64311.summary: Sir Dave Lewis will become chief executive of Diageo on January 1, replacing interim chief executive Nik Jhangiani. The Guinness maker is the source of the appointment.
nca20c64311.why: Diageo is a global spirits group whose brands include Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Smirnoff. Leadership changes at large consumer companies can shape strategy, capital allocation and investor confidence.

impacts.name: Diageo
impacts.why: The company is appointing a new chief executive to replace the interim head.

nc60f21dfea.headline: New York City commercial real estate industry seeks to work with Mamdani as rent freezes threaten
nc60f21dfea.summary: New York's real estate industry is bracing for ripple effects of Zohran Mamdani's affordability and housing policies and is seeking to engage with New York City. Rent freezes are cited as a threat.
nc60f21dfea.why: Rent regulation directly affects property valuations, lender exposure and the cash flows of landlords and real estate investment vehicles in New York City.

n49ac9fc729.headline: Unions expect Christodoulides to make next move over CoLA
n49ac9fc729.summary: Cypriot trade unions expect President Nikos Christodoulides to make the next move after employers rejected the government's latest proposal on the cost-of-living allowance. Unions say dialogue has been exhausted.
n49ac9fc729.why: The cost-of-living allowance is a wage supplement tied to inflation, so its design affects public and private sector pay costs in Cyprus.

n894b6ec6ca.headline: Senators take first step toward reopening the government after historic shutdown
n894b6ec6ca.summary: The Senate voted late Sunday on a compromise that could reopen the government after the longest shutdown in US history. The move is a first procedural step.
n894b6ec6ca.why: Government shutdowns delay federal data releases and spending, and investors watch them for effects on growth expectations and market sentiment.
n894b6ec6ca.why_moved: Progress toward reopening the government reduces uncertainty about federal spending and economic disruption, which supports risk appetite.

n0a89e5aea6.headline: London close: FTSE hits fresh high amid hopes of end to US shutdown
n0a89e5aea6.summary: London stocks ended sharply higher on Monday, with the FTSE reaching a fresh high. Hopes that the longest US government shutdown in history could end drove the gains.
n0a89e5aea6.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, and its moves reflect global risk sentiment.
n0a89e5aea6.why_moved: Hopes that the US government shutdown could end reduced uncertainty and lifted global equities.

n625724d5ae.headline: Trump floats $2,000 tariff rebate checks for most Americans in social media post
n625724d5ae.summary: In a social media post, the president floated the idea of $2,000 rebate checks for most Americans and called people who do not support tariffs "fools".
n625724d5ae.why: Tariffs are taxes on imported goods, and rebate checks would be a fiscal transfer to households, so both shape US inflation, government finances and trade policy expectations.

nbaed6f0e1b.headline: Ogonis wary of more oil drilling in Niger Delta
nbaed6f0e1b.summary: Reports of renewed oil drilling in the Niger Delta raise hopes for infrastructure and jobs, but residents blame oil extraction for environmental damage and impoverishment.
nbaed6f0e1b.why: The Niger Delta is Nigeria's main oil-producing region, and drilling decisions there affect national oil output and government revenue.

n948d273449.headline: Black Friday
n948d273449.summary: Brits are set to spend £4 billion more over this year's Black Friday weekend than last year. The figure points to higher consumer spending during the shopping event.
n948d273449.why: Black Friday is a key retail sales period, and consumer spending trends influence UK retailers and the wider economy.

n500fcca30a.headline: Entergy Arkansas plans $1.6bn investment to build Jefferson Power Station
n500fcca30a.summary: Entergy Arkansas plans a $1.6 billion investment to build the Jefferson Power Station. The combined cycle plant is designed to power more than 355,000 homes.
n500fcca30a.why: Entergy is a US electric utility, and large generation investments add to regulated rate base and power supply capacity.

ne2111db271.headline: CELAC and the EU sign 52 points in defense of multilateralism: these are the fundamental pillars of the Santa Marta Declaration
ne2111db271.summary: CELAC and the European Union signed a 52-point declaration defending multilateralism. Commitments cover climate change, global conflicts, trade and crime, though Venezuela and Nicaragua did not sign.
ne2111db271.why: CELAC is the Community of Latin American and Caribbean States, and the EU is a major trade and investment partner for the region. Shared trade commitments shape cross-regional commerce.

n494722b980.headline: Greece LNG Terminals, TITAN S&P Upgrade, Energy Costs
n494722b980.summary: Greece is advancing LNG terminal projects amid scrutiny of energy costs. Cement maker TITAN received an S&P upgrade, while the Superfund faces backlash over ELTA closures.
n494722b980.why: LNG terminals shape Greece's gas supply and energy costs. TITAN is a major Greek building materials group whose credit rating affects its borrowing costs.

nc1bffaa265.headline: Soybeans Rallying on Monday
nc1bffaa265.summary: Soybeans traded with 10 to 12 cent gains across most contracts on Monday. Soymeal futures were also up, while the national average cash bean price was 11 1/4 cents lower.
nc1bffaa265.why: Soybeans are a major agricultural commodity traded on the Chicago Board of Trade, and prices feed into food and animal feed costs worldwide.

n3582fea650.headline: Double Blow to Greek Banks from New ESBA Cuts
n3582fea650.summary: New ESBA plans and Ukraine's potential EU accession threaten Greek bank loans and economic growth, with EU funding reduced after 2028.
n3582fea650.why: Greek banks are the core of the country's financial system, and their loan books depend heavily on economic growth and EU funding flows.

n47119dd344.headline: eToro Posts 76% YoY Asset Growth, Stock Rises Around 7%
n47119dd344.summary: eToro's assets rose 76% to $20.8 billion in the third quarter, driven by crypto trading and AI tools, and it announced a $150 million share repurchase program.
n47119dd344.why: eToro is an online trading and investing platform, and its asset levels and buybacks reflect retail trading activity.

na50041e76e.headline: Primo Brands Announces Increase to Share Repurchase Program Authorization
na50041e76e.summary: Primo Brands' board has authorized an increase of $50 million to the company's existing share repurchase program, according to a company announcement dated November 10, 2025.
na50041e76e.why: Primo Brands is a US beverage company, and buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding, which can support per-share metrics.

n63cb990d91.headline: Senate Deal Reached to End the Govt Shutdown
n63cb990d91.summary: The Senate was voting on the first steps to end the 40-day government shutdown after moderate Democrats agreed to proceed without a guaranteed extension of health care subsidies.
n63cb990d91.why: A federal shutdown halts many government services and delays economic data releases, so its resolution affects sentiment about US fiscal policy and the broader economy.
n63cb990d91.why_moved: The Senate advancing a deal to end the shutdown reduces the uncertainty of a prolonged federal funding lapse, according to the input.

nad3241e8f5.headline: Bernie Sanders bemoans vote that broke shutdown stalemate
nad3241e8f5.summary: Senator Bernie Sanders criticised part of his caucus for abandoning healthcare demands, specifically the expiring Obamacare subsidies, in the vote that broke the shutdown stalemate.
nad3241e8f5.why: Government shutdowns delay federal spending and Obamacare subsidies affect insurance premiums for millions of Americans.

n4f651b5f55.headline: Ringgit appreciates to strongest level since October 2024
n4f651b5f55.summary: The ringgit strengthened to its highest level since October 2024, lifted by improved risk appetite. Optimism over a possible resolution to the US government shutdown also supported the currency.
n4f651b5f55.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves reflect global risk sentiment and capital flows into emerging Asian markets. US fiscal developments affect the dollar and regional currencies.
n4f651b5f55.why_moved: Improved risk appetite and growing optimism over a possible resolution to the US government shutdown lifted the ringgit against the dollar.

nd9e6703bfd.headline: Ex-ANZ execs lose bonus millions after record fine
nd9e6703bfd.summary: The former chief executive of ANZ and three of his executives have lost multimillion-dollar bonuses after a record fine. The bank is described as grappling with the consequences.
nd9e6703bfd.why: ANZ Group is one of Australia's four major banks, and fines and clawbacks affect its earnings, governance and regulatory standing.

nbe76fa32f1.headline: Bursa ends higher as strong economic data lifts investor confidence
nbe76fa32f1.summary: Bursa Malaysia ended higher as strong economic data lifted investor confidence. Analysts cited a resilient labour market, a firmer ringgit and a steadier global risk environment.
nbe76fa32f1.why: Bursa Malaysia is the Kuala Lumpur stock exchange, and its benchmark index tracks the largest Malaysian listed companies.

n9620f7c2ad.headline: New NCA Campaign Warns Men Off Crypto Investment Scams
n9620f7c2ad.summary: The UK's National Crime Agency launched a campaign warning men under 45 that crypto investment dreams can quickly turn into scams. The campaign targets fraud in digital asset investing.
n9620f7c2ad.why: Crypto investment fraud causes significant consumer losses and draws regulatory scrutiny of digital asset marketing in the UK.

nb7df5402a5.headline: Budget 2026: Pre-budget talks begin, chaired by Nirmala Sitharaman; tax reforms and manufacturing push in focus
nb7df5402a5.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the first pre-Budget consultation with leading economists in New Delhi, with tax reforms and a manufacturing push in focus.
nb7df5402a5.why: India's Union Budget sets fiscal policy, taxes and public spending for the year. Pre-Budget talks signal the policy priorities investors watch.

n169dd3039e.headline: Sensex, Nifty Snap 3-Day Losing Streak, IT & Auto Stocks Lead Market Rebound On Global & Domestic Optimism
n169dd3039e.summary: Sensex rose 319 points and Nifty gained 82, ending a three-day losing streak. Buying in IT, auto and select banking stocks lifted sentiment, while the rupee stayed near 88.66 amid RBI intervention.
n169dd3039e.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices of Indian equities, tracking large companies on the BSE and NSE. The rupee's level affects foreign investor returns and import costs.
n169dd3039e.why_moved: Buying in IT, auto and select banking stocks, plus optimism over the US government shutdown resolution, lifted sentiment.

n7ebf5b2f86.headline: RBI and CPE Announce Joint Venture to Reignite Growth at Burger King® in China
n7ebf5b2f86.summary: CPE will invest $350 million of primary capital in Burger King China, aiming to grow the chain to over 4,000 restaurants by 2035.
n7ebf5b2f86.why: Restaurant Brands International owns the Burger King brand, and its China growth is part of its strategy to expand net restaurant growth. Joint ventures with private equity capital are a common way to fund international expansion.

n399da7ca60.headline: German home prices climb again with large cities leading the way
n399da7ca60.summary: German residential property prices rose 3.8% in the third quarter from a year earlier, with sharp increases in major cities, vdp data showed.
n399da7ca60.why: The Association of German Pfandbrief Banks (vdp) publishes residential property price indices that are watched by investors in German mortgage lenders and covered bonds. Housing prices also influence Germany's broader economic and credit conditions.

na9fe98838e.headline: Propanc Biopharma Secures up to $100 million for Crypto Treasury
na9fe98838e.summary: Propanc Biopharma has secured up to $100 million in funding to add crypto to its balance sheet and advance its cancer treatment development.
na9fe98838e.why: Corporate crypto treasury strategies expose listed companies' balance sheets to digital asset price swings.

na0582fe8b3.headline: Beyond Meat forecasts subdued quarterly sales as demand remains weak
na0582fe8b3.summary: Beyond Meat posted a bigger quarterly loss and forecast fourth-quarter sales below Wall Street estimates. The plant-based meat maker cited sluggish demand for its products.
na0582fe8b3.why: Beyond Meat is a US plant-based meat producer whose sales trends are watched as a gauge of consumer demand for alternative protein.

n62e2e13a47.headline: Bitdeer Q3 Revenue Jumps 174% as Shares Drop Nearly 20%
n62e2e13a47.summary: Bitdeer's third-quarter revenue rose to $170M as mining output doubled and AI plans advanced. A $267M paper loss sent its stock down nearly 20%.
n62e2e13a47.why: Bitdeer is a bitcoin mining company that has been expanding into AI computing, so its results reflect both crypto mining economics and AI infrastructure demand.
n62e2e13a47.why_moved: Revenue growth from higher mining output was overshadowed by a $267M paper loss, and the stock fell nearly 20% following the report.

n466d90f056.headline: Rumble to Purchase Northern Data after Tether Investment
n466d90f056.summary: Rumble announced three deals involving stablecoin issuer Tether as part of its third-quarter report. The deals include Rumble's purchase of Northern Data.
n466d90f056.why: Rumble is a video platform that has been expanding into cloud and computing assets, and Tether is the largest stablecoin issuer by market capitalisation.

nd020e27332.headline: Wendy's to close hundreds of US stores in bid to halt falling profit
nd020e27332.summary: Wendy's plans to close hundreds of U.S. restaurants over the next few months in an effort to boost its profit. The move is aimed at reversing falling profit.
nd020e27332.why: Wendy's is a major US fast-food chain, and restaurant closures affect its earnings, franchise economics and sales outlook.

impacts.name: Wendy's
impacts.why: Closing restaurants is a restructuring step aimed at improving profitability.

ndc35ba00e7.headline: SBP Allows Banks’ Board Members to Work in Subsidiaries
ndc35ba00e7.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan has decided to allow banks' board members to work in their wholly-owned subsidiaries. The move aims to strengthen institutional arrangements between banks and subsidiaries.
ndc35ba00e7.why: The State Bank of Pakistan is the country's central bank and banking regulator, and its governance rules shape how lenders and their subsidiaries operate.

nfa3a5eeda3.headline: Former Cathay Cineplexes operator mm2 Asia faces S$74.6 million debt repayment demand from UOB
nfa3a5eeda3.summary: Former Cathay Cineplexes operator mm2 Asia faces a S$74.6 million debt repayment demand from UOB, along with repayment demands from landlords over closed cinemas.
nfa3a5eeda3.why: United Overseas Bank is one of Singapore's largest banks, and its recovery actions shape credit losses in the local banking sector.

nd5eb6c5e11.headline: Markets rejoice potential end to US government shutdown
nd5eb6c5e11.summary: Global markets were set to start the week higher as investors cheered the prospect of an imminent end to a historic US government shutdown.
nd5eb6c5e11.why: A US government shutdown can delay official economic data and weigh on confidence, so its resolution tends to support equity markets.
nd5eb6c5e11.why_moved: Investors cheered the prospect of an imminent end to a historic U.S. government shutdown, lifting global market sentiment.

n69bc6d3ac8.headline: SBP Governor urges capital market infrastructure improvement
n69bc6d3ac8.summary: State Bank of Pakistan Governor Jameel Ahmad said Pakistan has achieved significant macroeconomic stability through coordinated policy. He urged improvements to capital market infrastructure.
n69bc6d3ac8.why: The State Bank of Pakistan is the country's central bank, and its policy shapes the rupee, inflation and financial markets.

n5dbbd33480.headline: Competition Bureau says algorithmic rent pricing a concern, but not widespread
n5dbbd33480.summary: The federal Competition Bureau says it has not found evidence that software-recommended rent pricing is anti-competitive, but remains concerned about possible issues.
n5dbbd33480.why: Algorithmic pricing tools can use non-public competitor data, which raises competition-law and regulatory questions for landlords and property managers.
